محمد بن سالم بن عبد الرحمن الأزدي

notes: The report number «40 -» and the date phrase «في شوال سنة...» are excluded
The Imam stands inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator (owner ruling 2); the saying is his exegesis, and «رسولُ الله» and «عليٌّ» inside it are not links
